audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 and 2 are swapped against the packet. Both layers read Gnar / Skill at Levels 1 and 2; the packet reads Skill / Gnar. The page's own text agrees with the packet: whys[0] literally opens 'Even start', and whys[1] calls Level 2 'a free chunk' for Gnar.
audit.why: Level 1 Irelia shoves with Bladesurge and sets up the dash-in, which is why the page calls it even; Level 2 is the Hyper third-hit window before Flawless Duet exists. Rows 3-7 already match.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 flipped as one group in both layers with ratings moved to match.

audit.why: Four spikes present and real: Lvl 2 Hyper window, Lvl 3-5 Irelia's stretch, Lvl 6 Mega flip, first item. Ability naming corrected inside spikes[3] rather than restructuring.
audit.corrected: Defiant Dance and Bladesurge named in spikes[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Defiant Dance a 'shield' that 'blocks and heals through your Mega burst' in four places. Riot's W text says she charges a strike and takes reduced PHYSICAL damage during the charge — no shield, no healing, and no reduction of magic damage at all. The healing is Bladesurge (Q). No cooldowns appear anywhere either.
audit.why: Two consequences the reader is being denied. Because the reduction is physical-only and applies during a charge she has to commit to, Gnar's Hyper magic damage goes straight through it and the charge itself is a window rather than a wall. And because the sustain is Bladesurge, which refreshes on a Marked target or a minion kill, denying her the wave is what shuts the healing off — Grievous Wounds is aimed at the Q, not the W.
audit.corrected: Defiant Dance re-described as physical damage reduction during a charge and the heal re-attributed to Bladesurge in wants.foe[1], whys[5] and spikes[3]; Flawless Duet's 13s and Bladesurge's 8s plus reset condition written into the cooldown block, the do's and Key Ability Interactions.
sources: enemyKit Irelia Q text and heal flag, cd 10/9/8/7/6
